I found eight items you can use, plus some I'd leave out. The last 14 days were thin on new paid programs that suit Indian beginners. The strongest fresh items are two creative tools you can sell as a service and one live job board. I found no new official scam advisory from 14 to 28 Oct, and some bullets rely on blogs or news sites rather than the company's own page.

**Fresh and usable (14 to 28 Oct 2026)**

1. **Canva Craft, Canva's own image model (22 Oct).** It makes images up to 2K in about 30 sizes. Canva trained it on its templates, like posters, menus and infographics. It's in the Dream Lab tab for all users. I couldn't confirm how much the free plan allows. **Who earns:** students and homemakers doing poster, menu and offer-post design for local shops, sold as a service (CLIENT, GIG). Company source: [canva.com newsroom](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-craft/).

2. **OpenTrain AI's job board has Indian-language evaluator roles posted 26 Oct.** They're remote and part-time, at about $15 to $30 an hour (paid in dollars). One listing says $20 an hour for about 20 hours a week. **Who earns:** anyone fluent in Hindi or another Indian language, by rating and reviewing AI answers (SITES). Company source: [opentrain.ai/jobs](https://www.opentrain.ai/jobs/). **Catch:** listings close fast and these are contract roles. Check each one on the page before you quote it.

3. **CapCut's ChatGPT plugin, announced at CapCut World LA (24 Oct).** You start a video idea in ChatGPT, it builds a draft with CapCut tools, and you finish in CapCut's web editor. It's still "coming soon", with no date or price. **Who earns:** people making reels for local businesses, once it's live (CLIENT). This one is only a teaser for now. Source: an [X post](https://x.com/AGTPinsights/status/2114532058471248166). I couldn't find CapCut's own post.

4. **CapCut World Creator Program 2026.** The page lists a "Growth" tier paying $300 to $2,000 a month based on performance, plus free AI credits. It's recruiting for visual design and AI prompt creation. Source: [creator.capcutworld.com](https://creator.capcutworld.com/). **Caution:** I couldn't confirm that this domain belongs to CapCut, or that India is eligible. Treat it as unconfirmed and keep it out of reels for now.

5. **YouTube is testing a lower payout threshold in India.** Starting with October 2026 payments, a random group of creators in the US, India and Indonesia can withdraw below the usual $100 minimum. **Who earns:** small faceless-channel creators get paid sooner (PRODUCT). Source: [Social Media Today](https://www.socialmediatoday.com/news/youtube-tests-reduced-payment-threshold-for-creators/872965/). I found no Google page confirming it. **Catch:** it's a random test, so most creators won't see it.

**Background, older than 14 days (label it if you use it)**

6. **Upwork's AI work is growing while Fiverr shrinks.** Upwork says AI-related work grew more than 22% to about $330M a year (10 Aug filing). Its February report said AI video generation and editing demand was up 329%. Fiverr's active buyers fell 21.9%. **Who earns:** freelancers who sell AI video editing (SKILL, a ranking or side-by-side reel). Sources: [selfemployed.com](https://www.selfemployed.com/news/ai-freelance-skills-demand-2026/), [Fiverr stats page](https://www.fiverr.com/resources/guides/reports/freelancing-and-future-of-work-statistics).

7. **Student AI deals (only useful as cheap tools for a service).** Third-party sites say Google AI Plus is free for 12 months for Indian students until 31 Dec 2026, but they disagree on the details. They also say ChatGPT Go's free year for Indian users ends in early November 2026, and Gemini's free tier moved to an auto-selected model on 9 Oct. These are not ways to earn, so they only fit as a "what you need to start" line. Source: [felloai.com](https://felloai.com/how-to-claim-your-free-google-ai-pro-for-students/). Check Google's own student page before posting.

**Scam angle (SITES, "how to spot a fake")**

8. **There's no new official advisory, but the pattern hasn't changed.** It starts on WhatsApp or Telegram with small paid "tasks" like reviews or likes. Then come "prepaid tasks" or a "VIP group" fee. One Ahmedabad victim lost ₹30.5 lakh to Google Maps review tasks. A newer twist from August is fake jobs that ask you to open a bank account or hand over your SIM, which turns you into a money mule. **Who benefits:** everyone in your audience. The real line is that genuine AI training work never charges a fee. To report fraud, call 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in. Sources: [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/sci-tech/2026/08/04/new-cyber-scam-warning-your-job-application-could-make-you-a-money-mule.html), [Substack on the TOI case](https://markanthonydyson.substack.com/p/ai-fake-recruiters-task-scams-and), [HerWorkCircle](https://www.herworkcircle.com/guides/ai-training-jobs-from-home-india).

**What I left out**
- **Claude Duet (21 Oct):** it's for US Pro and Max users only, by invite.
- **GPT-6 Pro update:** it's for paid users, with no way to earn from it.
- **ElevenLabs:** nothing new in the window.
- **Instagram's long-form "Features":** it's being tested in Brazil and the US only, with no pay model yet.
- **Contests:** none open right now. Google's ₹1 crore "Fund My Crazy" closed 15 Sept.

Before any of these go in a reel, check them against docs/MONEY.md. The house rules only allow platforms on that list or ones confirmed on the company's own site. Items 1 and 2 meet that today. The rest need a company page first.
